record.hypothesis: The source is a four-second, 120-frame VP9 WebM with one Cluster. A packet-copy remux produces eight roughly half-second Clusters without recoding the VP9 packets. All 120 packet hashes and the complete FFmpeg framemd5 sequence are identical. Chromium presents 120 frames from both files with zero dropped frames. The candidate is only 76 bytes larger. Cluster splitting remains a parser/delivery boundary optimization. It does not create new keyframes or random-access points.
